name: East Fork Chippewa River
blurb: East Fork Chippewa River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.putIn: Chippewa River Access — Town of Chippewa
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.routeReview: The dotted line shows the approximate East Fork Chippewa River course between these listed access areas. Shoreline connections, usable depth and passage around wood or road crossings are not mapped. Confirm current conditions locally. This upper section is separate from the downstream Winter hydro itinerary.

sections.accessReview: The listed take-out area is beside the Winter powerhouse, downstream of the separate diversion dam. The project license specifies canal-side and tailrace landings joined by a canoe carry, but their current condition and exact approaches have not been established. Do not plan a continuous float to this marker or enter the canal or intake without confirming the signed access and carry locally.
sections.routeReview: Winter is a diversion-and-powerhouse project, not a single barrier at the map pin. The 2006 project map places the diversion upstream of the powerhouse area. The 2005 license describes a carry between the downstream end of the canal and upper tailrace. No precise approach or carry is mapped here, and the current route remains under review.

notices.title: Winter hydro: carry and landing review
notices.text: The project license describes separate canoe landings and a carry around the powerhouse. This is historical facility documentation, not confirmation of present access. Check the designated landing and portage with the manager before launching; keep clear of the diversion dam, canal intake and powerhouse.
notices.sourceName: FERC Winter Project 2064 license — recreation condition 8, page 42 (2005)
